_comment: What it costs an Age's instability budget to come apart at the bottom (design 5.3). The dearest
thing in the price list and the only one that ends the Age: fissures open at the world floor,
widen, and put whatever falls in back in the overworld. Each step bought is how fast the tear
spreads. Priced so that only an Age written to be unsalvageable can reach it -- with the defaults
above it, that is an instability index in the twenties.
